subject.title: feat(ledger): instrument review and apply actions

question: Should required immutable-ledger publication failures deliberately fail the workflow job after successful primary work, while primary-result gates still permit required continuations?
rationale: The code and tests intentionally implement this split availability contract; deciding whether audit-durability failure should produce a red production job requires explicit maintainer intent rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve split contract
options.body: Keep primary actions and continuations independent, but fail the job when required ledger publication is not durable.

options.title: Make publication warning-only
options.body: Preserve a green job after successful primary work and report ledger publication failure through warnings and recovery signals.

options.title: Pause the stacked rollout
options.body: Hold this base and its dependent PRs until one lifecycle contract is selected for all ledger operation families.

recommendation.title: Approve split contract
recommendation.body: Keep primary actions and continuations independent, but fail the job when required ledger publication is not durable.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch history and focused tests show direct ownership of the ledger architecture and this exact failure contract.
